intent: Build a kanban project management app with drag-and-drop, labels, due dates, filters, and data persisted to localStorage, then review it for accessibility.

spec.goal: Build a kanban project management app with drag-and-drop, labels, due dates, filters and localStorage persistence, and then review it for accessibility.
spec.deliverable: A working kanban web app plus a written accessibility review of that app.
constraints: Cards can be moved between columns using drag-and-drop.
Cards support labels and due dates.
App data is persisted in the browser's localStorage.
The app must be reviewed for accessibility after it is built.
done_criteria: Cards can be dragged and dropped between columns.
Labels and due dates can be set on cards, and the board can be filtered.
Board data is still present after reloading the page, via localStorage.
A written accessibility review of the app is provided, listing findings.
spec.summary: You want a kanban project management app with drag-and-drop, labels, due dates, filters and localStorage saving, followed by an accessibility review of it.
